initiative.title: Sequence diagrams as explanations
initiative.summary: A sequence diagram holds to its source, measures what it draws, says what each message is, and explains itself in an export.
initiative.next_action: Every committed milestone is shipped. Byron decides whether to retire the initiative or start an Explore item.

sources.anchor: Pro report, plan, 26 recommendations and 22 fixtures
14 November 2026: no dash in new words; activation bars on a switch; answers= alone makes a reply; fragments stay out

claims.statement: A sequence diagram must explain an exchange without the prose round it.
The drawing must never guess a meaning from a line's style or position.

shape.appetite: Four milestones: correct, measure, mean, explain.
shape.problem: A sequence ignored group order, drew misleading phases, let labels cover lifelines and could not say what a message was.
shape.recommended_shape: Keep nodes and edges. Add kinds of message on the edge, a local action, measured layout and a key.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Milestones M2 to M4 land with PR #560.

implementation.fast_local_loop: pnpm vitest run tests/sequence.test.ts tests/sequence-meaning.test.ts; pnpm shoot examples/login-sequence.draft tmp/out.png

milestones.title: Correct existing sequences
milestones.outcome: Order holds, phases are runs of messages, deletion works and measured ink has room.

milestones.title: Measure the complete explanation
milestones.outcome: Compact headers, wrapped phase labels with a gap between bands, and a label in one gap clear of each lifeline.
evidence: PR #560; tests/sequence.test.ts; the plan's distant-label fixture gives lane centres 36, 228, 308

milestones.title: Explicit event meaning
milestones.outcome: message= kinds, answers=, the action line, a key, source edits, CLI edits, and insert and move in the editor.

milestones.title: Useful focus and standalone exports
milestones.outcome: A call shows its reply when selected. An export has the key, the order caption and a description in words.

milestones.title: Activation bars
milestones.outcome: layout root sequence activations=on draws a bar from each call to the reply that answers it. Added by Byron on 14 November 2026; the plan had deferred it.
